question: How changed files are written to disk

routes.reasoning_given: A file is never half-written; a temp file in .troupe/ would not be atomic across filesystems
routes.route: Temp file in the same directory, fsync, copy permissions, os.replace; only changed files are touched

routes.reasoning_given: All texts are computed and verified first, so only an OS error during the write remains
routes.route: Write in place with newline='' only when the text changed, no temp files
